PROXY_RESILIENCE_FIELDS.OFF_EVERY_CALL_I: Off — every call is attempted, however long the vendor has been unreachable.
PROXY_RESILIENCE_FIELDS.PAUSE_CALLS_TO_A: Pause calls to an unreachable vendor for {{subject}}
PROXY_RESILIENCE_FIELDS.RETRIED_ON_429_5: Retried on 429, 502, 503 and 504, and when a call does not complete. Any other answer — a 4xx included — comes back as it is.
PROXY_RESILIENCE_FIELDS.SECONDS_ONE_IS_T: seconds. One is then let through to see whether it is back. A vendor that answers is not a failure here, even when it answers with an error. The count is per vendor host for this proxy, kept separately for public callers, signed-in callers, workflows and tests.
